_what_this_is: Which public code units the test suite EXECUTES, measured from a coverage run. Supports B1 (executed and recorded); it does NOT support CHECKED, because executing a unit is not judging whether it refuses honestly. Generated by scripts/suite_coverage.py.

untouched_split._what_this_means: Of the units the suite never touched, these execute at IMPORT time (every class body does) versus nowhere at all. Measured in a subprocess so that coverage starts before vfairness is imported. Recorded to describe the untouched pile accurately; it is NOT counted towards B1, because running a class body is not recording a result.
